title: JobExecution
description: A single execution instance of a scheduled job, capturing its status and timing information.

executionID.description: Unique identifier of this job execution.

jobID.description: Unique identifier of the parent job.

executionNumber.description: Sequential execution number for this job, starting at 1.

scheduledStartTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this execution was scheduled to start.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this execution actually started.

finishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this execution completed or failed.

snapshotNotebookPath.description: Path to the snapshot notebook created after execution, if snapshot creation was enabled.
